shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.description: How, when, and where we ship ONE 10 GLOBAL orders within the United States.

runs.text: Last updated: January 2026 · Applies to all orders placed on one10globalllc.com
Orders placed before
1:00 PM Central Time

on a business day are processed the same day. Orders placed after that cutoff, or on weekends and US federal holidays, are processed the next business day. You will receive a confirmation email with tracking information as soon as your label is generated.

items.text: Standard Shipping (free on orders over $50):
3–6 business days after processing. Orders under $50 ship for a flat $5.95.
Expedited Shipping ($12.95):
2–3 business days after processing.
Priority Shipping ($24.95):
1–2 business days after processing.

runs.text: Delivery estimates are provided by the carrier and are not guaranteed. Weather events, carrier delays, and peak-season volume can extend transit times. We will notify you by email if we become aware of a significant delay affecting your order.
We ship to all 50 US states, Washington D.C., and US territories via USPS, UPS, and FedEx.
We currently do not ship internationally.
We do not ship to PO boxes for expedited or priority orders; standard shipping to PO boxes is available.

Shipping charges are calculated at checkout and are based on order weight, destination, and selected service level. Applicable state and local sales tax is calculated at checkout based on the shipping address. ONE 10 GLOBAL LLC collects sales tax in states where we have established economic nexus, in accordance with applicable state law.
If tracking shows your package as delivered but you cannot locate it, please check with neighbors and your building's mail area first, then contact us within
7 days
of the marked delivery date at
support@one10globalllc.com
. We will open a carrier trace and, if the package cannot be located, ship a replacement or issue a full refund at our discretion.
If your order arrives visibly damaged, please photograph the packaging and contents before opening further and contact us within
48 hours
of delivery. We will arrange a replacement at no cost.

Please verify your shipping address at checkout. If you need to change an address after placing an order, email us immediately — we can usually update it if the order has not yet shipped. Once an order has shipped, address changes are not possible and the order will be delivered to the original address. Orders returned to us as undeliverable will be refunded minus the original shipping cost.
You may cancel an order at no charge if it has not yet shipped. Email
support@one10globalllc.com
with your order number as soon as possible. Once an order has shipped, it is subject to our
Returns & Refunds Policy
Shipping questions:
support@one10globalllc.com
or (236) 506-1948, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds Policy
returns.description: Thirty days, no restocking fee, and a real person on the other end.

runs.text: Last updated: January 2026 · Applies to all orders placed on one10globalllc.com

Return any unused item within 30 days of delivery in its original packaging for a full refund of the purchase price. We do not charge restocking fees. Return shipping is free for defective or incorrect items.
You may return most items within
30 calendar days
of the delivery date shown on your carrier tracking. Returns initiated after 30 days may be declined or issued as store credit at our discretion.
To qualify for a full refund, items must be:

items.text: Unused and in the same condition you received them
In the original packaging, including all included accessories, hardware, and documentation
Free of damage caused after delivery, including scratches, stains, and odors

runs.text: Items returned in a condition that does not meet these requirements may be subject to a partial refund reflecting the loss in value, or may be returned to you at your expense.

items.text: Email
returns@one10globalllc.com
with your order number and the reason for the return.
We will reply within one business day with a Return Authorization number and shipping instructions.
Pack the item securely in its original packaging and write the Return Authorization number on the outside of the box.
Ship to the address provided. Returns sent without a Return Authorization number may be refused.
Defective, damaged, or incorrect items:
We provide a prepaid return label. No cost to you.
Change of mind, ordered by mistake, or no longer needed:
You are responsible for return shipping costs. We recommend a trackable service, as we cannot refund items lost in transit back to us.

runs.text: Once your return is received and inspected at our Dallas facility, we will notify you by email. Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within
3 business days

of inspection. Your bank or card issuer may take an additional 5–10 business days to post the credit. Original shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error or a defective product.

We do not process direct exchanges. To get a different item, return the original for a refund and place a new order. This ensures you receive the replacement as quickly as possible and avoids inventory hold times.

items.text: Items marked "Final Sale" at the time of purchase
Items returned more than 30 days after delivery
Items damaged through misuse, alteration, or improper cleaning
Products missing original packaging, parts, or accessories

runs.text: If a product fails due to a manufacturing defect within its warranty period, this is handled as a warranty claim rather than a return. See our
Warranty page
or email
support@one10globalllc.com
with photos of the defect and your order number.
If your order arrives damaged or you received the wrong item, contact us within
48 hours
of delivery with photos of the packaging and product. We will ship a correct replacement at no cost or issue a full refund, including original shipping charges.
Returns team:
returns@one10globalllc.com
Returns address: ONE 10 GLOBAL LLC — Returns Dept., 10228 E Northwest Hwy, Dallas, TX 75238

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.description: Limited warranty coverage on every ONE 10 GLOBAL product.

runs.text: Last updated: January 2026

ONE 10 GLOBAL LLC warrants that its products will be free from defects in materials and workmanship under normal household use for the applicable coverage period. If a product fails due to a manufacturing defect, we will repair or replace it, or refund the purchase price, at our option.

items.text: Normal wear and tear, including surface scratches and cosmetic fading
Damage from misuse, abuse, or use inconsistent with the product instructions
Damage from improper cleaning, including dishwasher use where not stated as safe

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What we collect, why we collect it, and how you can control it.

runs.text: Last updated: January 2026 · Effective date: January 1, 2026

ONE 10 GLOBAL LLC ("ONE 10 GLOBAL," "we," "us," or "our") operates one10globalllc.com. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect personal information when you visit our site, place an order, or contact us. We are the data controller for information collected through this site.

items.text: Order information:
name, shipping address, billing address, email address, phone number, and order contents
Account information:
email address and password if you create an account
Communications:
the content of emails, contact form submissions, and support requests
Payment information:
processed by our third-party payment processor. We do not store full credit card numbers on our servers.
IP address, browser type, device type, and operating system
Pages viewed, time on page, referring URL, and exit pages
Cookies and similar tracking technologies (see Section 5)
To process, fulfill, and ship your orders
To communicate about your order, including confirmations, shipping updates, and delivery issues
To process returns, refunds, and warranty claims
To respond to your questions and support requests
To detect and prevent fraud, unauthorized transactions, and abuse
To comply with legal obligations, including tax and consumer protection laws
To improve our products, site, and customer experience
To send marketing emails if you have opted in (you may unsubscribe at any time)

runs.text: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only in the following circumstances:

items.text: Service providers:
shipping carriers (USPS, UPS, FedEx), payment processors, email service providers, and analytics providers who process data on our behalf under contractual confidentiality obligations
Legal requirements:
when required by law, subpoena, court order, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of ONE 10 GLOBAL, our customers, or others
Business transfers:
in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, in which case your information may be transferred as part of the transaction
With your consent:
for any other purpose you specifically authorize

runs.text: We use cookies and similar technologies to keep your cart contents, remember your preferences, and analyze site traffic. You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may limit your ability to use certain features, including the shopping cart.
We may use third-party analytics services that collect information about your use of the site. These providers have their own privacy policies governing their use of your information.
If you are a California resident, you have the right to:

items.text: Know what personal information we collect, use, and disclose
Request deletion of your personal information, subject to certain exceptions
Request correction of inaccurate personal information
Opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information (we do not sell personal information)
Not be discriminated against for exercising your privacy rights

runs.text: Residents of Virginia, Colorado, Connecticut, Utah, and other states with comprehensive privacy laws may have similar rights. To exercise any right, email
privacy@one10globalllc.com
. We will verify your identity and respond within 45 days.

We retain order and transaction records for at least 7 years to comply with tax and accounting requirements. Marketing contact information is retained until you unsubscribe or request deletion. Support communications are retained for 3 years.

We use industry-standard safeguards including TLS/SSL encryption for data in transit, access controls, and encrypted storage for sensitive information. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Our site is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we learn that we have collected such information, we will delete it promptly. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, contact
privacy@one10globalllc.com

Our site is intended for US customers. If you access the site from outside the United States, your information will be transferred to and processed in the United States, where privacy laws may differ from those in your jurisdiction.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.description: Our commitment to making one10globalllc.com usable for everyone.

runs.text: Last updated: January 2026

ONE 10 GLOBAL LLC is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We continually improve the user experience for everyone and apply relevant accessibility standards to our website and communications.
We aim to conform to the
Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA

. These guidelines explain how to make web content more accessible for people with a wide range of disabilities. We are actively working toward full conformance and conduct periodic reviews of the site.

items.text: Semantic HTML structure with proper heading hierarchy
Descriptive alternative text for meaningful images and decorative artwork
Keyboard navigation support throughout the site
Visible focus indicators on all interactive elements
Sufficient color contrast between text and background
Form fields with associated labels and clear error identification
Support for reduced-motion preferences via
prefers-reduced-motion
Responsive layouts that work at 200% zoom without loss of content

runs.text: We are aware of the following limitations and are working to address them:

items.text: Some product illustrations are decorative SVG graphics marked with
aria-hidden
; equivalent information is always provided in text form nearby.
Third-party payment and analytics tools may not fully conform to WCAG 2.2 AA. We select vendors that demonstrate accessibility commitment where possible.

runs.text: We welcome your feedback on the accessibility of one10globalllc.com. If you encounter an accessibility barrier, or if you need information from this site in an alternative format, please contact us:

items.text: Email:
access@one10globalllc.com
Mail: ONE 10 GLOBAL LLC — Accessibility, 10228 E Northwest Hwy, Dallas, TX 75238

runs.text: We aim to respond to accessibility feedback within 2 business days and to resolve confirmed issues within 30 days where feasible.
If you are not satisfied with our response to an accessibility concern, you may contact the U.S. Department of Justice or file a complaint with the appropriate state or federal agency.
